name: Content Reporting Charts
description: Submodule of Content Reporting that renders the tracked engagement data as column, bar and pie charts using the contrib Charts module.
project_description: Content Reporting Charts is a submodule of Content Reporting that visualises the data collected in the content_reporting_reports and content_reporting_interactions tables. It defines a single controller and theme that render three graphs on a charts dashboard at /content-reporting/charts-dashboard: views-per-page (column chart), average time-spent for anonymous vs authenticated visitors (bar chart), and average time-spent per page (pie chart). Rendering is delegated entirely to the contrib Charts module via its render elements (#type chart, chart_data, chart_xaxis, chart_yaxis); the submodule bundles no chart library of its own, so the actual library (Chart.js, Highcharts, ApexCharts, etc.) is whichever the Charts module is configured to use. Requires the content_reporting parent module and charts:charts.
